subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw add non-USD currency semantics for configured model costs, and should that currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request adds a high-bar public config surface and changes how cost estimates are represented across status output, session state, usage summaries, UI aggregation, docs, and USD-named telemetry/API fields.

options.title: Define contract first
options.body: Choose the currency scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so all cost surfaces stay consistent.

options.title: Keep USD-only estimates
options.body: Leave configured model costs as USD-only and treat non-USD provider prices as unsupported until a stronger product case appears.

options.title: Add display-only symbol
options.body: Implement a narrow symbol formatter while explicitly leaving stored values and telemetry as USD-like estimates, accepting mixed-currency ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Define contract first
recommendation.body: Choose the currency scope and accounting/display semantics before implementation so all cost surfaces stay consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans cost UI, config semantics, docs, status output, and stored/API naming, matching this handle's recent area history.
